name: xAI
look: Near-black canvas where white outline pills are the entire interactive vocabulary, with mono uppercase labels against weight-400 display.

hero.title: Understand the universe
hero.sub: A frontier model trained for reasoning and real-time knowledge, with an API that does not pretend the world stopped at the training cutoff.

features.title: Reasoning, and knowing what happened today
features.sub: Two things most models are bad at, treated as the primary design targets.

items.title: Reasoning
items.body: Extended chain-of-thought with the intermediate steps available, so you can audit how a conclusion was reached.

items.title: Real-time knowledge
items.body: Grounded in a live index rather than frozen at a training cutoff months ago.

items.title: Tool use
items.body: Structured function calling with schema adherence measured and published.

items.title: Vision
items.body: Reads charts, diagrams and screenshots at full resolution rather than a downsampled thumbnail.

items.title: Code
items.body: Strong on long-context refactors where the relevant callers are hundreds of files away.

items.title: Fast
items.body: Speculative decoding and a custom serving stack keep first-token latency under two hundred milliseconds.

showcases.title: The steps are available, not hidden
showcases.body: Extended reasoning is exposed rather than summarised away. When the model reaches a wrong conclusion you can see which step turned, which is the only way to fix a prompt rather than guess at it.

showcases.title: Built by a small team, on purpose
showcases.body: A deliberately small research organisation with a single frontier model line rather than a portfolio. Everything published — model cards, evaluations, safety framework — covers that one line properly.

gallery.title: API
gallery.sub: Reference, quickstarts and the tool-calling schema.

testimonial.quote: Being able to read the reasoning steps changed how we write prompts. We stopped guessing at what confused it and started reading where it turned.
testimonial.name: Nadia Rahman

pricing.title: PRICING
pricing.sub: Per token, published, with no enterprise tier hiding the number.

items.a: Responses are grounded in a live index updated continuously, rather than only in weights frozen at a training cutoff. Sources are cited so you can check them.
Yes, on Pro and above. Intermediate steps are returned as a separate field rather than folded into the answer.

items.q: Do you train on API data?
items.a: No. API inputs and outputs are excluded from training, and there is no setting to remember or form to submit.
One million tokens, evaluated at depth with the per-depth results published, including where accuracy falls off.

cta.title: START BUILDING
cta.sub: Five dollars of credit, no card, full model access.

notes: White outline pills are the entire interactive vocabulary. Filled buttons appear once, for sign-up, and nowhere else.
The two-face contrast is the brand voice: weight-400 display against mono uppercase tracked labels.
Cards are tight 8px rectangles on a slightly lighter fill with a hairline border. There are no shadows.
A muted accent palette exists in the tokens but stays off the marketing surface, reserved for product illustration.
Display headlines carry heavy negative tracking — around -2.4px at 96px — for a precise, gathered look.
